# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt
Compare finding existing decision rationale with creating a new decision note and choose the clearer fit when prior records may already answer the task.

## Expected selection
use

## Why
The task is to discover whether existing rationale already answers the route.

## Expected object
A compact decision lookup that verifies graph matches against source notes.

## Boundary notes
This is an aoa-decision-find case, not an aoa-decision-create case.

## Verification hooks
- use graph or generated-index lookup first
- verify claims against source notes
- route missing evidence to create or correct
